caveats: Largest tested family/configuration, not the absolute maximum of the FPGA.
The highest-capacity image has only 4 bytes spare beyond its reserved 4 KiB stack; peak stack usage was not measured.
Meshes above 338 vertices were tested with compact replies; the experiment does not add general raw support for them.
All four application modes are retained; larger-image runtime sweeps exercise banana and transport specifically.
The existing viewer still fixes mesh/scale and caps replies at 613 words; it was not switched to any experimental mesh.
Rates are reciprocal mean fresh-request latency, not measured display throughput; host/physical-link costs are separate.
Automatic placement selects CPU banana computation with zero TPU backend calls.
More triangles retain INT8 geometry precision; some denser reduced meshes contain quantization-degenerate faces. The selected maximum has none.
